Senior Full Stack Developer (PHP Laravel) for Custom Web Applications
Posted yesterday

Worldwide

Summary

We're looking for a highly skilled Full Stack Developer with deep experience in PHP Laravel to help build custom web applications from concept to production.

What You'll Be Doing
• Build custom Laravel applications from Webflow designs and specifications
• Convert front-end assets into clean, scalable, maintainable code
• Develop APIs, admin panels, user dashboards, authentication systems, and custom business logic
• Ensure responsive behavior across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices
• Optimize performance, security, and database architecture
• Work closely with founders to rapidly bring new ideas to market

Requirements
• 5+ years of PHP Laravel experience
• Strong understanding of MySQL and database design
• Experience building SaaS products, directories, marketplaces, or custom web applications
• Excellent front-end skills (HTML, CSS, JavaScript)
• Comfortable working from Webflow designs and AI-generated front-end code
• Strong attention to detail
• Ability to spot inconsistencies and proactively solve problems
• Fast execution without sacrificing code quality
• Strong communication skills
